info.name: JobFindLink V2 API
info.description:
JobFindLink v2 API Collection — Updated 2026-05-07

=== VARIABLES ===
base_url   = http://127.0.0.1:8000
auth_token = (set after login or verify-otp)
temp_token = (set from verify-otp response for new users)

=== UNIVERSAL LOGIN FLOW (Employee & Employer) ===
1. POST /api/auth/send-otp   { mobile, purpose: 'login' }
2. POST /api/auth/verify-otp { mobile, otp_code }
   → Existing user: returns access_token + full profile + next_screen
   → New user:      returns temp_token → show account type selection

=== REGISTRATION ===
Employee: POST /api/auth/employee/register { mobile, temp_token }
Employer: POST /api/auth/employer/register { mobile, temp_token, company_name, email, password, location, company_size }

=== EMPLOYEE PROFILE SETUP ===
After employee registration, complete profile in 7 steps:
Step 0: Upload Resume (optional/skippable)
Step 1: Basic Details
Step 2: Job Preference
Step 3: Location & Salary (current_salary + expected_salary)
Step 4: Skills & Languages
Step 5: Education (optional/skippable)
Step 6: Work Experience (optional/skippable)
Step 7: Resume & Availability (marks profile complete)

item.name: 1. Authentication

request.description: Confirm API server is running.

STEP 1 — Send OTP to a 10-digit Indian mobile number.
purpose values: register | login | forgot_password | resend
OTP is valid for 5 minutes.
Rate limited: max 3 requests per 10 minutes per number.

STEP 2 — Verify 6-digit OTP. Works for BOTH Employee and Employer.

RESPONSE (existing user — any role):
  is_new_user: false
  data.access_token   → store as auth_token
  data.next_screen    → e.g. 'employee_dashboard', 'employer_dashboard', 'profile_setup_step_0'
  data.profile_step   → current setup step (employees only)
  data.profile        → full profile object

RESPONSE (new user):
  is_new_user: true
  temp_token  → store as temp_token, use in Register step
  next_screen: 'select_account_type'

STEP 3A — Register Employee after OTP verify.
Only mobile + temp_token needed. No password.
Response includes access_token and profile_step: 0 (start profile setup).

STEP 3B — Register Employer after OTP verify.
Required: mobile, temp_token, company_name, email, password, location, company_size.
company_size options: 1-10 | 11-50 | 50-200 | 200-500 | 500+

item.name: Login via Mobile OTP (Employee OR Employer)

request.description:
Universal OTP Login — works for BOTH Employee and Employer.
First call: POST /api/auth/send-otp (purpose=login)
Then call this endpoint with the OTP received.

Response includes:
  access_token, refresh_token
  next_screen → 'employee_dashboard' | 'employer_dashboard' | 'profile_setup_step_N'
  profile_step (employees only)
  profile object

NOTE: POST /api/auth/verify-otp also handles login automatically for existing users.
Employer-only alternative login using email and password.\nEmployers can also login via mobile OTP using POST /api/auth/login/otp.
Send mobile to reset via OTP — works for BOTH Employee and Employer.\nEmployer can also send email field instead of mobile for email-based reset.
Email-based password reset OTP — Employer only.
Submit new password with OTP. Use email instead of mobile for employer email reset.

Returns full user + profile for any role.
Also returns:
  next_screen  → where the app should navigate
  profile_step → current setup step (employees only)
Exchange current token for a new access + refresh token pair.
First call send-otp for the new mobile, then call this with the received OTP.

item.description:
AUTH FLOW:
1. Send OTP  → POST /api/auth/send-otp
2. Verify OTP → POST /api/auth/verify-otp
   - Existing user: auto-login (any role), returns access_token + next_screen
   - New user: returns temp_token → go to account type selection
3a. Employee Register → POST /api/auth/employee/register (mobile + temp_token)
3b. Employer Register → POST /api/auth/employer/register (mobile + temp_token + company details)

LOGIN (returning users):
  Both Employee & Employer → POST /api/auth/login/otp (mobile OTP)
  Employer only (alt)       → POST /api/auth/employer/login (email + password)

request.description:
Get full employee record with current profile_step (0–7) and profile_completed flag.
Use this to resume profile setup after app restart.
Skip resume for now. Employee can upload at Step 7 or later from dashboard.

Required: full_name, gender (male|female|other)
Optional: mobile_number, email
For profile_photo: use multipart/form-data with 'profile_photo' (JPG/PNG max 2MB)

Required: seeking_position, experience_type (fresher|experienced)
If experienced: exp_years (0–40) and exp_months (0–11) are required.

Required: preferred_locations (array, min 1 city)
Optional: current_salary (Current CTC in ₹/month), expected_salary (Expected CTC in ₹/month)
Get city list from: GET /api/locations/gujarat-districts

Required: skills (array, min 1)
Optional: languages (array of language names)

education_level: below_10th | 10th | 12th | diploma | graduate | post_graduate | phd
college_name + degree_name required for: diploma, graduate, post_graduate, phd
specialisation is optional
Education is optional. Send skip:true to move to Step 6.

employment_type: full-time | part-time | shift | contract
Set currently_working:true and end_date:null for current job.
notice_period: Immediate | 15 days | 30 days | 60 days | 90 days

body.raw:
{
    "company_name": "ABC Tech Pvt Ltd",
    "industry_sector": "Information Technology",
    "employment_type": "full-time",
    "start_date": "2022-06-01",
    "end_date": null,
    "currently_working": true,
    "notice_period": "30 days"
}

request.description: Work experience is optional (for freshers). Send skip:true to move to Step 7.

FINAL STEP — Marks profile as complete (profile_completed: true).
Required: availability (immediately | within_7_days | flexible)
Optional: resume file via multipart/form-data (PDF max 5MB) if not uploaded in Step 0.
Response: profile_completed: true
Returns: applied_count, shortlisted_count, offered_count, profile_views, recommended_jobs
Bulk update — for editing existing profile fields after initial setup.
